title: Checks for construction of a structure or tuple just to assign a value in it.
summary: Readability. If the structure is only created to be updated, why not write the structure you want in the first place? Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for #[test] in doctests unless they are marked with either ignore, no_run or compile_fail.
summary: Code in examples marked as #[test] will somewhat surprisingly not be run by cargo test. If you really want to show how to test stuff in an example, mark it no_run to make the intent clear. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Triggers when a testing function (marked with the #[test] attribute) isn’t inside a testing module (marked with #[cfg(test)]).
summary: The idiomatic (and more performant) way of writing tests is inside a testing module (flagged with #[cfg(test)]), having test functions outside of this module is confusing and may lead to them being “hidden”. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
